description: Defines the MojoAudioDecoderService class, a final implementation of mojom::AudioDecoder, providing methods for initializing, decoding, resetting, and managing audio decoding via Mojo IPC in the Chromium media component.

classes.name: MojoAudioDecoderService
classes.description: A final class implementing mojom::AudioDecoder, managing audio decoding operations with Mojo IPC, including initialization, decoding, reset, and buffer handling.

methods.name: MojoAudioDecoderService
methods.description: Constructor initializing the service with media client and CDM context.

methods.name: Construct
methods.description: Sets up the client and media log for the decoder.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with configuration and optional CDM ID.

methods.name: SetDataSource
methods.description: Sets the data source handle for decoding.

methods.name: OnReadDone
methods.description: Callback after reading from decoder buffer.

methods.name: OnWaiting
methods.description: Handles waiting reasons such as decryption key wait.
